cause: Installed audioconv64 stereo VADPCM padding uses a scalar-sample pointer with a frame count, overwriting 16 frames near the midpoint of 16-modulo-32 input and leaving its DMA tail uninitialized.
fix: Prealign stereo loop copies and zero-pad transport PCM to 32 frames before audioconv64. Restore exact original playback/loop header lengths after encoding; canonical source PCM is unchanged.

runtime.method: Unmodified ares v148 executable code, private settings, diagnostic14, no debugger/frame breakpoints
runtime.scope: AI busy state measures the emulated N64 output queue. Host audio-device underruns and listening quality are not measured.
